p: Rav Yosef bar Ḥavu raised a contradiction before Rabbi Abbahu:
Yom Kippur does not atone for sins committed against a fellow person, but isn’t it written: “If one man sin against another, God [Elohim] shall judge him [ufilelo]”
“But if a man sin against the Lord, who shall entreat [yitpallel] for him?”
is saying: If one man sins against another, God [Elohim] shall forgive him [ufilelo];
But if a man sin against the Lord, who shall entreat [yitpallel] for him? Repentance and good deeds.
